headline: Say everything on your mind. ALIBI turns it into a planned day.

highlights.title: Brain dump that plans your day
highlights.body: Every task you mention gets its own line and a time slot. Keep the suggestion or drop it with one tap.

highlights.title: A calmer Today page
highlights.body: Your day reads like a clean diary page: times on the left, a tick on the right, and a pen stroke through what's done.

highlights.title: Voice typing that gets you right
highlights.body: Talk naturally in English or Hinglish. Every word lands once, and ALIBI keeps listening while you think.

highlights.title: Never miss what's new
highlights.body: New versions now show up right here with a one-tap download.
